cards.ex: Investigative journalism played a key role in uncovering the corruption scandal.
cards.exUz: Surishtiruv jurnalistikasi korruptsiya janjalini fosh qilishda muhim rol o'ynadi.
cards.uzDef: Jurnalistlar tomonidan chuqur va batafsil tergov o'tkazish, yashirin faktlarni ochish.

cards.ex: The upcoming anniversary provided a news peg for revisiting the historical event.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi yubiley tarixiy voqeani qayta ko'rib chiqish uchun yangilik tayanchi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi voqeaning asosiy sababi yoki boshlanishi, yangilikning asosiy nuqtasi.

cards.ex: The journalist relied on reliable sources to verify the accuracy of the information.
cards.exUz: Jurnalist ma'lumotning to'g'riligini tekshirish uchun ishonchli manbalarga tayandi.
cards.uzDef: Tasdiqlangan va xolis ma'lumot beradigan manbalar, haqiqatni aniqlashga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: The newspaper's editorial policy leans towards environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Gazetaning tahrir siyosati atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Nashriyotning mavzularni yoritish, fikrlarni bildirish bo'yicha rasmiy yo'nalishi.

cards.ex: Some media outlets tend to sensationalize the story to attract more viewers.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi ommaviy axborot vositalari ko'proq tomoshabinni jalb qilish uchun voqeani shishirishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani hayajonli va dramatik ko'rsatish, haqiqatni buzib ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: The president held a press conference to address the recent economic crisis.
cards.exUz: Prezident so'nggi iqtisodiy inqirozga munosabat bildirish uchun matbuot anjumani o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim bayonot berish yoki savollarga javob berish uchun tashkil etilgan tadbir.

cards.ex: Freedom of the press is essential for a democratic society.
cards.exUz: Matbuot erkinligi demokratik jamiyat uchun muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Jurnalistlarning senzurasiz yoki cheklovlarsiz fikr bildirish huquqi.

cards.ex: Journalists often face ethical dilemmas regarding source protection.
cards.exUz: Jurnalistlar ko'pincha manbalarni himoya qilish bilan bog'liq axloqiy dilemmalarga duch kelishadi.
cards.uzDef: Jurnalistlarning o'z manbalarini sir saqlash majburiyati, ularni himoya qilish.

cards.ex: The story was published in the public interest to expose wrongdoing.
cards.exUz: Voqea noto'g'ri harakatlarni fosh qilish uchun jamoatchilik manfaatini ko'zlab e'lon qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyat uchun foydali bo'lgan narsalar, barcha odamlar uchun muhim bo'lgan masalalar.

cards.ex: The fact-checking process is crucial for maintaining journalistic integrity.
cards.exUz: Faktlarni tekshirish jarayoni jurnalistik halollikni saqlash uchun juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotlarning to'g'riligini aniqlash uchun qilinadigan tekshiruvlar, xatolarni tuzatish.

cards.ex: The report presented a slanted view of the situation, ignoring key facts.
cards.exUz: Hisobot vaziyatga bir tomonlama qarashni taqdim etdi, muhim faktlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga xolis bo'lmagan, o'z manfaati uchun yo'naltirilgan nuqtai nazar.

cards.ex: The editorial board decided to publish the controversial article.
cards.exUz: Tahririyat kengashi bahsli maqolani nashr etishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Gazeta yoki jurnalning siyosatini belgilaydigan va maqolalarni ko'rib chiqadigan guruh.

cards.ex: Social media platforms are trying to curb misinformation by flagging false posts.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media platformalari noto'g'ri postlarni belgilash orqali noto'g'ri ma'lumot tarqalishini to'xtatishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yolg'on yoki noto'g'ri ma'lumotning tarqalishini cheklash, oldini olish.

cards.ex: The newspaper is proud of breaking the story about the political scandal.
cards.exUz: Gazeta siyosiy janjal haqidagi voqeani birinchi bo'lib yoritganidan faxrlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqea haqida birinchi bo'lib xabar berish, yangilikni birinchi bo'lib e'lon qilish.

cards.ex: All sources have to be vetted before their information can be used in the article.
cards.exUz: Barcha manbalar ularning ma'lumotlari maqolada ishlatilishidan oldin tekshirilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot yoki shaxsning to'g'riligi, ishonchliligi tekshirilishi.

cards.ex: The press plays a watchdog role by holding politicians accountable.
cards.exUz: Matbuot siyosatchilarni javobgarlikka tortish orqali nazoratchi rolini o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalarining hokimiyatni kuzatib borish, qonunbuzarliklarni fosh etish roli.

cards.ex: The reporter investigated the claims with due diligence before publishing the story.
cards.exUz: Reportyor hikoyani nashr etishdan oldin da'volarni kerakli e'tibor bilan tekshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Har bir ishni diqqat bilan, barcha zarur tekshiruvlarni o'tkazgan holda bajarish.

cards.ex: The company issued a press release announcing the new product launch.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi mahsulotning ishga tushirilishi haqida matbuot relizini chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Tashkilot tomonidan jurnalistlarga tarqatiladigan rasmiy bayonot yoki xabar.

cards.ex: After years of rivalry, the two newspapers decided to bury the hatchet.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik raqobatdan so'ng, ikkita gazeta urushni to'xtatishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchiliklarni unutib, yarashish, do'stona munosabatlarni tiklash.

cards.ex: His stunt journalism involved living homeless for a month to understand poverty.
cards.exUz: Uning stunt jurnalistikasi qashshoqlikni tushunish uchun bir oy davomida uysiz hayot kechirishni o'z ichiga olgan.
cards.uzDef: Jurnalistning o'z tajribasini hikoya qilish uchun xavfli yoki noodatiy ishlarni qilishi.

cards.ex: The magazine decided not to run the story because of lack of evidence.
cards.exUz: Jurnal dalillarning yetishmasligi sababli hikoyani e'lon qilmaslikka qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Gazeta yoki jurnalda biror voqea haqida maqola e'lon qilish.

cards.ex: It took the journalist a while to get a handle on the complex situation.
cards.exUz: Jurnalist murakkab vaziyatni tushunishga biroz vaqt sarfladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunish, muammoni hal qilishga kirishish.

cards.ex: The scandal created a feeding frenzy among the media outlets.
cards.exUz: Janjal ommaviy axborot vositalari orasida oziqlanish ishtahasini yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalarining bir voqeani haddan tashqari yoritishi, bahsga aylantirishi.

cards.ex: The media has the power to shape public opinion on important issues.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari muhim masalalar bo'yicha jamoatchilik fikrini shakllantirishga qodir.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy fikrga ta'sir qilish, odamlarning biror narsaga bo'lgan nuqtai nazarini o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: The report is under embargo until tomorrow morning.
cards.exUz: Hisobot ertaga ertalabgacha ta'qiq ostida.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni ma'lum bir vaqtgacha e'lon qilmaslik kelishuvi.

cards.ex: The news program included a vox pop to gauge public reaction to the new law.
cards.exUz: Yangiliklar dasturi yangi qonunga jamoatchilik munosabatini baholash uchun xalq ovozini o'z ichiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'cha savollari orqali odamlarning fikrlarini bilish, qisqa intervyular.

cards.ex: The news agency hired a stringer to cover the events in the remote village.
cards.exUz: Yangiliklar agentligi olis qishloqdagi voqealarni yoritish uchun erkin muxbirni yolladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z hududidan yangiliklar yuboradigan, gazetaga bog'liq bo'lmagan jurnalist.

cards.ex: The scandal was blown out of proportion by the yellow press.
cards.exUz: Janjal sariq matbuot tomonidan kattalashtirildi.
cards.uzDef: Hayajonli, ammo ishonchsiz ma'lumotlarni chop etadigan gazeta yoki jurnal.

cards.ex: The interviewer held the politician's feet to the fire over his broken promises.
cards.exUz: Intervyu beruvchi siyosatchini buzilgan va'dalari uchun qattiq tanqid qildi.
cards.term: hold someone's feet to the fire
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qattiq tanqid qilish, savollar bilan qiynash, javobgarlikka tortish.

cards.ex: The documentary used archival footage as its source material.
cards.exUz: Hujjatli film arxiv kadrlardan manba materiali sifatida foydalangan.
cards.uzDef: Maqola yoki reportaj yozish uchun ishlatiladigan asosiy ma'lumotlar, hujjatlar.
